question: The average weight of Tushar, Salil and Mukund is 46 kg. If the average weight of Tushar and Salil be 40 kg and that of Salil and Mukund be 46 kg, then the weight of Salil (in kg) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Weight of Salil = (Sum of Tushar & Salil) + (Sum of Salil & Mukund) − (Sum of Tushar, Salil & Mukund)

⇒ Salil's weight = (2 × 40) + (2 × 46) − (3 × 46)

⇒ Salil's weight = 80 + 92 − 138

⇒ Salil's weight = 172 − 138 = 34

**∴ The correct answer is 34 kg.**
